title: Rare 1911 Denver Mint gold coin found in family safe-deposit box could fetch $500,000+
summary_full: A remarkable discovery has surfaced—a $10 gold coin from 1911 that was hidden away in a family safe deposit box. Graded PCGS MS 65 and sanctioned by Certified Acceptance Corporation, this rare find is projected to sell for over $500,000 at an auction in January 2027. With only about 1,650 known examples in existence, such rare items often remain undetected until expert grading brings them into the spotlight.
